subtitle: The Captain at the Spring

briefing.text: The root focus is broken. Defeat the Root-Crown Mother to end her hold on the spring.
The united watch approaches the willow through the inlet. Break the forward guards and destroy the root focus at the springhead, then defeat the Mother. Orra and Mares must survive.

victory.text: Both crews heard your orders. Both came home. I will not split this company again.
Then call the watch together. We keep the spring, and we keep the willow’s standing roots out of the saws.
That sounds like an order, Captain Orra.

debrief: The Mother’s root focus lies broken. The watch holds the spring and works only the already cleared bank. Both crews recognize Orra as their captain.
